functional_requirements.statement: A member can borrow a seed packet from the library catalog.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a member in good standing, when they borrow an available seed packet, then the packet is marked as on loan to that member.
Given a member who already holds six packets, when they try to borrow another, then the loan is refused with a message naming the limit.
Given a packet that is on loan, when a second member searches the catalog, then the packet shows as unavailable with its due date.

functional_requirements.statement: A member can return a borrowed seed packet at the desk or the drop box.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a packet on loan, when it is returned at the desk, then the loan is closed and the packet is available again.
Given a packet returned after its due date, when the loan is closed, then the overdue days are recorded on the member's account.
Given a packet returned through the drop box, when the volunteer checks the box, then the return is confirmed by scanning the packet label.

functional_requirements.statement: A grower can donate saved seed to the library with notes on the variety.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a grower with saved seed, when they fill in the donation form with the variety name and year, then a donation record is created for review.
Given a donation record, when a librarian approves it, then a new packet is added to the catalog with the grower credited.
Given a donation of a restricted species, when the form is submitted, then it is rejected with a reference to the restricted species list.

functional_requirements.statement: A member can renew their annual membership online.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a member whose membership expires within thirty days, when they pay the renewal fee, then the expiry date moves forward by one year.
Given a failed card payment, when the renewal is attempted, then the membership is unchanged and the member sees the reason.
Given a successful renewal, when the payment clears, then a receipt is emailed to the member.

functional_requirements.statement: A member can record germination results for a borrowed variety.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a member with a returned loan, when they submit germination counts, then the result is attached to the variety page.
Given germination counts where sprouted exceeds sown, when they are submitted, then the form is rejected with a validation message.
Given several germination results for one variety, when the variety page loads, then the average germination rate is shown.

functional_requirements.statement: A volunteer can sign up for desk shifts.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an open desk shift, when a volunteer signs up, then the shift lists the volunteer and the open count drops by one.
Given a volunteer already signed up for a shift, when they cancel more than a day ahead, then the shift reopens.
Given a shift within a day, when a volunteer cancels, then the coordinator is notified by text message.

functional_requirements.statement: The library runs a spring plant sale with a list of seedlings.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given the sale calendar, when the sale opens, then the seedling list is published on the public page.
Given a seedling with no remaining stock, when a visitor views the list, then it is marked sold out.
Given a sale order, when the visitor confirms it, then the order total includes the member discount for members.

functional_requirements.statement: A member can book a place at a seed-saving workshop.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a workshop with free places, when a member books, then a place is held and a confirmation is shown.
Given a full workshop, when a member tries to book, then they are offered the waiting list.
Given a booked place, when the member cancels, then the place goes to the first person on the waiting list.

functional_requirements.statement: A librarian can mark a packet as lost and charge the member.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a packet overdue by more than sixty days, when the librarian marks it lost, then the member is charged the replacement fee.
Given a lost packet that is later returned, when the librarian reverses the loss, then the replacement fee is refunded.
Given a packet marked lost, when the catalog is searched, then the packet no longer appears.

functional_requirements.statement: Members receive a monthly newsletter by email.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a member who has opted in, when the monthly send runs, then the newsletter is emailed to that member.
Given a member who unsubscribes, when the next send runs, then they are not emailed.
Given a bounced address, when the send completes, then the member is flagged for the librarians to follow up.

functional_requirements.statement: Visitors can browse the catalog by plant family.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given the public catalog, when a visitor picks a plant family, then only packets of that family are listed.
Given a family with no packets, when a visitor picks it, then an empty-state message suggests the donation form.
Given a long list of packets, when the visitor scrolls past twenty packets, then the next twenty are loaded.

functional_requirements.statement: The library prints a label for every packet with its variety and sowing season.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a packet in the catalog, when a librarian prints its label, then the label shows the variety name and the sowing season.
Given a label, when it is scanned at the desk, then the packet record opens.
Given a variety with no sowing season, when a label is printed, then the season line is left blank.

functional_requirements.statement: Members with overdue packets receive reminders.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a loan one day overdue, when the nightly job runs, then the member is sent a reminder by email.
Given a loan fourteen days overdue, when the nightly job runs, then the member is sent a second reminder and a librarian is notified.
Given a member who returns the packet, when the next nightly job runs, then no reminder is sent.

functional_requirements.statement: Donating growers can have a public profile page.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a grower with at least one approved donation, when they enable their profile, then a public page lists their donated varieties.
Given a grower who disables their profile, when the page is requested, then it returns not found.
Given a profile page, when it is shown, then no email address or phone number appears.

functional_requirements.statement: Volunteers check packets out to members at the desk with a barcode scanner.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a member card and a packet label, when the volunteer scans both, then the loan is created and the due date is shown.
Given a member card that has expired, when the volunteer scans it, then the desk screen blocks the loan and shows the expiry date.
Given a scanner that fails to read a label, when the volunteer types the packet code, then the loan is created the same way.

functional_requirements.statement: Members can search varieties by name or by a growing trait.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given the search box, when a member types part of a variety name, then matching varieties are listed with their packet counts.
Given a growing trait filter, when a member picks drought tolerance, then only varieties with that trait are listed.
Given a search with no results, when it completes, then the member is offered the donation request form.

functional_requirements.statement: The library hosts a yearly seed swap where members trade packets.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given the swap date, when registration opens, then members can register with a count of packets they will bring.
Given a member who registered, when they arrive, then the volunteer checks them in against the list.
Given the end of the swap, when the volunteer closes the event, then leftover packets are added to the catalog.

functional_requirements.statement: A librarian can waive fees for a member in hardship.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a member with outstanding fees, when a librarian grants a waiver with a reason, then the fees are cleared.
Given a waiver, when it is granted, then the librarian and the reason are recorded on the account.
Given a waiver request without a reason, when the librarian submits it, then it is rejected.

functional_requirements.statement: Donors can add a photo of the plant to a packet record.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a packet record, when a librarian uploads a photo, then the photo appears on the packet page.
Given a photo larger than five megabytes, when it is uploaded, then it is rejected with the size limit.
Given a photo that is not an image, when it is uploaded, then it is rejected.

functional_requirements.statement: The board receives an annual report of loans and donations.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given the end of the year, when the report is generated, then it lists the number of loans and the number of donations.
Given the report, when the board opens it, then each figure is compared with the year before.
Given a year with no donations, when the report is generated, then the donation figure shows zero rather than being omitted.

functional_requirements.statement: Donated seed is held in quarantine before it joins the catalog.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an approved donation, when the packet is created, then it is held in quarantine for fourteen days before it can be borrowed.
Given a packet in quarantine, when a member searches the catalog, then the packet is shown with the date it will become available.
Given a packet whose quarantine has ended, when the nightly job runs, then the packet becomes available for loan.

functional_requirements.statement: Members can opt in to a directory of local growers.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a member who opts in, when the directory page loads, then their first name and neighbourhood are listed.
Given a member who opts out, when the directory page loads, then they no longer appear.
Given the directory, when a member contacts a grower, then the message is relayed without revealing either email address.

functional_requirements.statement: Attendees can leave feedback after a workshop.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a workshop that has ended, when an attendee opens the feedback form, then they can rate it from one to five and add a comment.
Given an attendee who already left feedback, when they open the form again, then their earlier answer is shown for editing.
Given the feedback of a workshop, when the organiser opens the summary, then the average rating and the comments are listed.
